page_title: TOT 4-1 WHU | Tottenham Hotspur v West Ham 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.

90+7' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post.
90+6' Tottenham players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
90+4' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
90+3' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Andy Madley blows for a foul after Emerson (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
88' It's time for a substitution. Archie Gray (Tottenham) comes on in place of Destiny Udogie.
86' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) has to leave the pitch!

85' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham), but referee Andy Madley must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
84' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
84' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) receives a yellow card.
81' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) replaces Yves Bissouma.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dominic Solanke leaves the pitch and Richarlison (Tottenham) comes on.
81' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andy Madley saw the whole situation.
79' Some great controlled play and passing from Tottenham. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
76' Timo Werner (Tottenham) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
76' The statistic for corner kicks – 13:5.
74' Emerson (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
72' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Guglielmo Vicario.
70' Julen Lopetegui has decided to substitute Guido Rodriguez and he is replaced by Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Timo Werner (Tottenham) for Heung-Min Son.
67' Carlos Soler (West Ham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

67' A pass travels right across the box to Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola denies him with a decent save.
66' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
65' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
63' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
62' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.

61' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!
61' The substitution is prepared. Carlos Soler (West Ham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tomas Soucek.
61' Julen Lopetegui has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) replacing Michail Antonio.
61' Substitution. Edson Alvarez (West Ham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lucas Paqueta walks off.

60' 4 - 1 Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Alphonse Areola is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 4:1.
58' West Ham will take a corner kick.
56' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
55' 3 - 1 Alphonse Areola (West Ham) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
55' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
52' 2 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) was set free in the area by Destiny Udogie and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
51' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
48' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
47' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Pape Matar Sarr comes on the pitch for James Maddison (Tottenham).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
45+1' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' James Maddison (Tottenham) works the corner short.
44' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post.
43' What was Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
41' Michail Antonio (West Ham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
40' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
39' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
36' 1 - 1 James Maddison plays a neat ball into the path of Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the right post! 1:1.
35' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
34' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Alphonse Areola.
34' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
34' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
32' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:4.
32' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Andy Madley no option but to blow his whistle.
30' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
29' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
29' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
29' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
28' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
28' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
26' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
26' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
26' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for West Ham.
25' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
23' The resulting corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
23' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from James Maddison (Tottenham).
22' Tottenham are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
18' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Jarrod Bowen laid the ball off to Mohammed Kudus (West Ham), who shot from close range into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
18' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner kick, but Alphonse Areola reads it well and stops the effort.
16' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
16' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
13' Andy Madley couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) and blew his whistle.
11' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
11' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) hammers the ball towards the roof of the net, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Guglielmo Vicario, who denies him with a terrific save.
10' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
9' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' Tottenham take a short corner kick.
6' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
5' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) heads on.
5' Some neat passing and movement from Tottenham as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
3' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

2' A lofted cross from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Tottenham will take the kick-off.
Andy Madley will officiate today.
